[quote=vespurias;60321618]THE EXILES

"...Rom...ain...Geltgen-" Jim wrote down on a paper.

"[i]F[/i]eltgen, Imperial Steward." Humphrey corrected calmly.

"Oh yes, quite right. Anyways, what are we going to do? Do I meet with the PM, the royals with our imperials, and the Admiral with the bitch- I mean, the witch- I mean the Grand Princess Mary?" Jim asked, removing his glasses and only floundering two times in a row.

"Yes, that would be optimal. You can take the PM to a more cordial and official meeting here in Hyperion whilst we try and make sure our imperials don't look any more provincial than they already are." Humphrey said as Bernard wrote that down.

"Let's say, an afternoon here, lunch with their Prime Minister, and the Imperials can have something done outdoors, and let's have The Grand Princess handle her own meeting with the admiral." Humphrey planned out as he stood up, and Bernard wrote it down.

"Would it be wise or even permitted for the Grand Princess to handle the Admiral without ministerial oversight?" Bernard asked as he got the minutes down.

"I'd like to see you try and tell that woman [i]no[/i], in fact, the better if she has little reason to leave Kingsmount at all!" The Imperial Steward said, "So we're all set and such, then?"

"Right you are, Imperial Minister." Humphrey politely bowed his head, thankful the little visit had taken Hacker's mind off policy, letting it be rightfully handled by the Civil Service.

«★»

The Vespurian Imperial Embassy would deliver a few notes before their departure for them to be aware of. There are no fuel or any such fuel-based transports in Hyperion, no plane or air traffic permitted in its vicinity. There is a city North of Hyperion, Darlene, just halfway from Hyperion and Hearth, the latter of which is was the former capital of the Commonwealth of Hithers, also known formerly as the Hitherlands, a hilly region.

It is recommended to either take a land transport from that city to an outpost by the Imperial Center or otherwise use a teleportation station, whichever choice is most preferable, and of which the Crown will ensure the best quality and security of, assuming a plane is taken to Darlene, otherwise the closest port to the Elseyrian coast is the capital of Norrhollow Principality, which has a straight road or otherwise luxury train work leading towards a city Northeast of Hyperion known as Cornbridge by the Albic River. As for the Grand Princess' invitation of the Admiral, a plane or ship to Kingsmount would suffice. The Imperial Crown will both pay for all transports and would be most hopeful tor personally transport the Prime Minister, Royals and Admiral.

Upon arrival it is to be noted that the Prime Minister is invited to a personal lunch with the Imperial Steward and his Head of Civil Service for official discussions, plus an extra, whilst the Admiral is invited to do likewise with the Grand Princess and her family alongside a later more official meeting in her estate, meanwhile the Royal Family is invited to the Grand Imperial Estate which surrounds the great park area of the White Tree of Hyperion, for an open lunch outside with the Imperial Family of which the Emperor, Empress, Crown Prince, Crown Princess Consort, Imperial Prince & Heir alongside his sister the Imperial Princess will be in attendance.

Gifts, offers, and comforts have been prepared.[/quote]

"No...cars...no-no no nothing, what are we going to have to use, horse and carriage?"

Anneilen says reading their response while waiting for the plane to finish departure preparations, a copy of which was handed over to the royals to review before getting there. The admiral had decided to have them and the Prime Minister take the far more scenic route of land transport to Hyperion, while he simply took a ship to Kingsmont

"Oh no. Looks like somebody was sitting on their phone the entire time during the meeting, otherwise you would know that we were just going to use an electric car. Let's hope they don't do that during the dinner either..."

Gabriel quietly mumbles

"I...I wasn't going to do that anyw-" responds, having picked it up

"Sure. Just like you were also totally listening earlier, right? Because if you where you would have noticed the part where it says where taking an electric car" He says, rolling his eyes as he picks up his glass of whine, preparing to take the last few sips

"I was so!" Annelien says reactively

"Whatever. Just remember the most important thing. No. Magic."

"Gee, Ok, okay okay, whatever..."

Anneilen says, before the plane intercom says "Deboarding may now begin, you are now in. Darelene, Vespurias. Security will meet you at the end of the gate to escort you to your transport within the city. Have a great day."

______________________________________________________________________________________

[i]Upon leaving the airport, they are escorted both by Vespurian Security and the Royal Guards to an electric vehicle that belonged to the royal family and had been successfully taken from Velvetel and evacuated with the Remanent, it was a disguised armored Limousine specially built by Avelishu's, a world renowned vehicle producer that also had begun to specialize in luxury electric vehicles before the revolution. at Komend., and had been transported separately to Vespuria about a week prior to their visit. 

The drive would mostly take back routes as had been requested by the Prime Minister, before becoming the Education Minister he was a professor and a naturalist, and therefore by taking more rural roads not only could he observe the likely beautiful, unpolluted surroundings of Vesperia's countryside leading to Hyperion while he continued to read over his plans for discussion for lunch with the Imperial Steward, meanwhile members of the Royal Servants that had traveled with the remaining royals had also came along and where making final preparations making sure the outfits and appearances of the royals were as pristine as possible. As Hyperion's massive tree came into view the Prime Minister would temporarily have the transport stop to get some pictures of it for record keeping of the trip, before entering the city around a couple hours after they had arrived in the country.

Meanwhile at Kingsmount, The Grand Admiral had disembarked from a Floueschian Destroyer that had been used to transport him to Kingsmount and began to follow Vespurian Security forces to the Estate of the Grand Princess.    [/i]
